text:
olivia: quick thread — we need a tight deliverable pack for Enterprise Deploy Modes: 1-pager (security + SLAs + when to pick Hosted/Dedicated/Private), a short benchmark narrative (latency/cost vs common workloads), social/launch posts, and a webinar outline. target: sales & field next-week enablement. who can own which piece?

mike: I can take the benchmark narrative. will pull p50/p95 latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and one comparison chart (redwood hosted vs small dedicated cluster vs on-prem quantized). ETA: Thu EOD. :white_check_mark:

jess: I'll map inbound routing + AE handoff. thinking rules: Private prospects -> sales-led AE lane; Dedicated -> sales + solutions eng nurture; Hosted trial/PLG -> self-serve SDR cadence. will sketch flow and sample email copy.

kai: I'll do the 1-pager design and hero messaging. propose headline: "Predictable inference for enterprise: SLAs, security, and flexible deployment." Drafting 1 variant with icons for Security, SLAs, Deployment Modes. Need exact SLA bullets.

steph: I'll write the webinar outline and one-slide benchmark narrative. Proposed 30-min format: 10m product + 10m benchmarks + 8m customer Q&A + 2m CTA (book a demo). Also propose a short case vignette (healthcare/personal-data) to highlight Private.

leo: I can draft the social/launch posts and email subject lines. For social: short thread + link to one-pager + CTA to webinar signup. For enterprise channels, include compliance + KMS callouts.

olivia: awesome. mike — for benchmarking, include these workloads: chat-like conv (2k tokens), embedding batch (100k vectors), and high-throughput streaming gen (short replies). please include methodology snippet and perf caveats.

mike: noted. sample methodology blurb: "Requests run against same model family (quantization parity where applicable), 10k requests per workload, p50/p95/p99 measured, cost normalized to token accounting including KV cache effects." will put raw numbers in the doc.

jess: inbound rules draft:
```
if prospect.account_type == "enterprise_private": route -> AE_private_queue
elif prospect.region in EU and requires_govcloud: route -> GovCloud_AE
elif signups > trial_threshold: route -> SDR_plug_in -> Dedicated_sales_nurture
else: self-serve_funnel
```
will add sample Slack/HubSpot automation snippets.

kai: need final SLA bullets from Product: latency SLOs per route (hosted fast lane p50 < 80ms on 16k tokens? check) and uptime SLA (99.9% for Dedicated). steph, do we want an SLA callout on the webinar slide?

steph: yes — one slide, simple table: Deployment Mode | Typical Latency | Typical Unit Cost | SLA | Typical Use Case. keep it visual.

olivia: timeline: owners deliver first drafts by Thu EOD. Friday morning review with leadership (10 min sync). marketing to finalize assets by Mon for AE play next week. add promo checklist: webinar signup page, one-pager PDF, short demo recording, benchmark appendix.

leo: suggested short post copy: "New: Enterprise Deploy Modes from Redwood — choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private without rewriting your app. Join our webinar on April 10 to see benchmarks + migration guides. [signup link]"

mike: also adding a one-paragraph technical appendix with quantization notes and hardware profile (A10G vs H100 vs customer on-prem CPU quantized).

olivia: permissions question — for Private docs that mention on-prem configs, make sure the one-pager is public-friendly. keep detailed on-prem configs in gated appendix. (steph/jess: add gated download).

deploy-bot: webinar slot reserved: 2025-04-10T17:00:00Z — session created (ID: wb-1998).

jess: inbound routing quick copy for AEs: "If a lead requests data residency or managed private deployment, tag 'enterprise_private' and route to AE_private_queue. Use the Private quick-pack when setting up first touch."

kai: uploading a rough mock in Figma now -> https://figma.com/file/example-enterprise-1pager (placeholder).

olivia: ok, owners: mike (benchmarks + appendix), kai (1-pager + figma), steph (webinar + slides), jess (inbound routing + gated flow), leo (launch copy). reconvene Fri 09:00 PT for leadership review. thanks all! :rocket:
